job.name: ig44_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, женщина ~58 в светлом лаунже, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: героиня ~58, серебристое каре, льняная рубашка, светлый лаунж с баром
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame of an interview. A confident, elegant Russian woman about 58 with a short silver-grey bob haircut, fine natural wrinkles, light makeup, small pearl earrings, wearing a loose white linen shirt, no glasses. She sits on a chair in a calm modern hotel lounge, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, wise self-assured warm expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the chest up, both shoulders in frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: soft daylight lounge with a bar and plants, softly blurred. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
